points.title: 贵族童年
points.description: 罗素出生于英国威尔士的一个贵族家庭，是第三代罗素伯爵的孙子。他的童年充满悲剧，父母在他幼年时相继去世，由祖母抚养长大。尽管身处贵族环境，罗素却对传统宗教和道德产生了怀疑。这一时期，他接受了良好的古典教育，开始对哲学和数学产生浓厚兴趣，为他后来的学术生涯奠定了基础。这段经历塑造了他独立思考的品格和对权威的质疑精神。
points.descriptionEn: Russell was born in Wales to an aristocratic family, grandson of the third Earl Russell. His childhood was marked by tragedy as his parents died when he was young, and he was raised by his grandmother. Despite his aristocratic upbringing, Russell developed skepticism towards traditional religion and morality. During this period, he received a classical education and developed a keen interest in philosophy and mathematics, laying the foundation for his later academic career. This experience shaped his independent thinking and questioning attitude towards authority.

points.title: 剑桥求学
points.description: 罗素进入剑桥大学三一学院学习，师从哲学家麦克塔加特和数学家怀特海。在这里，他接触并深入研究数理逻辑，与怀特海合作完成了《数学原理》这一里程碑式著作。同时，他积极参与剑桥的学术辩论，开始形成自己的哲学思想体系。这段时期，罗素还结识了多位重要思想家，包括摩尔、凯恩斯等，这些友谊对他后来的思想发展产生了深远影响。剑桥的学术氛围塑造了他严谨的逻辑思维和对真理的追求。
points.descriptionEn: Russell attended Trinity College, Cambridge, where he studied under philosophers McTaggart and mathematician Whitehead. Here, he delved into mathematical logic and collaborated with Whitehead on the monumental work 'Principia Mathematica'. He actively participated in academic debates at Cambridge, beginning to form his own philosophical system. During this time, he met important thinkers including Moore and Keynes, whose friendships profoundly influenced his later intellectual development. Cambridge's academic atmosphere shaped his rigorous logical thinking and pursuit of truth.

points.title: 逻辑与和平主义
points.description: 罗素在伦敦担任伦敦政治经济学院讲师，同时继续他的哲学研究。这一时期，他完成了《数学原理》的写作，并在数理逻辑领域取得重大突破。同时，罗素积极参与和平主义运动，第一次世界大战期间，他因反战言论被剑桥大学解职，并被短暂监禁。尽管面临职业危机，罗素坚持自己的和平主义立场，认为战争是愚蠢且不道德的。这段经历强化了他对政治和社会问题的关注，使他逐渐从纯粹的学术研究转向更广泛的社会活动。
points.descriptionEn: Russell worked as a lecturer at the London School of Economics while continuing his philosophical research. During this period, he completed 'Principia Mathematica' and made significant breakthroughs in mathematical logic. Simultaneously, Russell actively participated in the pacifist movement. During World War I, he was dismissed from Cambridge and briefly imprisoned for his anti-war statements. Despite this professional crisis, Russell maintained his pacifist stance, believing war to be both foolish and immoral. This experience strengthened his focus on political and social issues, gradually shifting him from purely academic research to broader social activism.

points.title: 中国之行
points.description: 罗素应梁启超邀请访问中国，在北京大学担任客座教授。他在中国停留了一年多，向中国知识界介绍了西方哲学思想，特别是他的逻辑实证主义。同时，罗素对中国传统文化表现出浓厚兴趣，深入研究儒家和道家思想，并将其与西方哲学进行比较。这段经历对罗素的思想产生了深远影响，使他更加重视跨文化理解和东方智慧。罗素后来在《中国问题》一书中系统阐述了他对中国的看法，主张中国应走自己的发展道路，而非简单模仿西方。
points.descriptionEn: At the invitation of Liang Qichao, Russell visited China and served as a visiting professor at Peking University. He stayed in China for over a year, introducing Western philosophical ideas, particularly his logical positivism, to Chinese intellectuals. Simultaneously, Russell showed great interest in traditional Chinese culture, studying Confucian and Taoist thought and comparing them with Western philosophy. This experience profoundly influenced Russell's thinking, making him more appreciative of cross-cultural understanding and Eastern wisdom. Later, in 'The Problem of China,' Russell systematically presented his views on China, advocating that China should follow its own developmental path rather than simply imitating the West.

points.title: 流亡美国
points.description: 由于反对第二次世界大战和坚持和平主义立场，罗素在英国受到孤立，移居美国，在芝加哥大学和加州大学伯克利分校任教。在美国期间，他继续从事哲学研究，同时积极参与反战和民权运动。罗素对美国社会的种族歧视和资本主义制度提出批评，认为这些制度违背了真正的民主和自由理念。然而，随着二战的进展，罗素的态度发生了变化，他开始认识到纳粹主义的威胁，支持盟军对抗法西斯。这一时期，罗素的思想更加成熟，他开始将哲学思考与社会现实更紧密地结合起来。
points.descriptionEn: Due to his opposition to World War II and pacifist stance, Russell faced isolation in Britain and moved to the United States, teaching at the University of Chicago and UC Berkeley. During his time in America, he continued his philosophical research while actively participating in anti-war and civil rights movements. Russell criticized racial discrimination and the capitalist system in America, believing these institutions violated true democratic and liberal ideals. However, as World War II progressed, Russell's views evolved; he recognized the threat of Nazism and supported the Allies against fascism. During this period, Russell's thinking matured as he began to more closely connect philosophical thought with social reality.

points.title: 晚年与诺贝尔奖
points.description: 罗素返回剑桥大学，重新活跃于学术和政治舞台。1950年，他因'多样且重要的著作，捍卫人道主义理想和思想自由'而获得诺贝尔文学奖。晚年，罗素积极参与核裁军运动，发表《罗素-爱因斯坦宣言》，警告核战争的危险。他还强烈批评越南战争，成为反战运动的标志性人物。1960年代，罗素积极参与民权运动，反对种族隔离。直到去世前，他仍然保持着活跃的公共知识分子的角色，坚持自己的和平主义和人道主义立场。罗素的晚年体现了知识分子的社会责任感，他试图将哲学思考转化为实际行动，影响世界政治和社会发展。
points.descriptionEn: Russell returned to Cambridge University, becoming active again in academic and political circles. In 1950, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature 'for his varied and significant writings in which he champions humanitarian ideals and freedom of thought.' In his later years, Russell actively participated in the nuclear disarmament movement, issuing the Russell-Einstein Manifesto warning of the dangers of nuclear war. He strongly criticized the Vietnam War, becoming an iconic figure in the anti-war movement. In the 1960s, Russell participated in the civil rights movement, opposing apartheid. Until his death, he maintained his role as an active public intellectual, consistently upholding his pacifist and humanitarian ideals. Russell's later years exemplified the social responsibility of intellectuals, as he sought to translate philosophical thought into concrete action that influenced world politics and social development.

appraisal.zh: 罗素一般被看作20世纪最重要的哲学家之一，其逻辑分析深刻塑造了现代哲学，作为和平主义者与人道主义者，他毕生反对战争与不平等，著述遍及哲学、数学、政治与教育，诺贝尔文学奖既肯定其文笔，也表彰他对人类和平与自由的贡献。另一种看法认为，他的逻辑原子主义简化了世界的复杂性，和平主义在纳粹威胁前显得不切实际，其私人生活与对东方文化的理解也受非议，可见伟大思想家亦难脱时代局限。
appraisal.en: Russell is generally regarded as one of the foremost philosophers of the 20th century, whose logical analysis profoundly shaped modern philosophy; a pacifist and humanist, he opposed war and inequality throughout his life, wrote across philosophy, mathematics, politics and education, and his Nobel Prize in Literature honored both his prose and his service to peace and freedom. Another view holds that his logical atomism oversimplified a complex world, that his pacifism seemed impractical before the Nazi threat, and that his private life and his grasp of Eastern cultures have been faulted—great thinkers, too, remain bound by their time.

supporter.zh: 罗素是20世纪最伟大的哲学家之一，他的逻辑分析哲学对现代哲学产生了深远影响。作为和平主义者和人道主义者，他一生坚持真理和正义，反对战争和不平等。罗素的著作涵盖哲学、数学、政治、教育等多个领域，展现了他博学的知识和深刻的洞察力。他获得诺贝尔文学奖，不仅肯定了他的文学成就，也表彰了他为人类和平与自由所做的贡献。罗素的思想遗产至今仍在激励着人们追求理性、批判性思维和对人类福祉的关怀。
supporter.en: Russell is regarded as one of the greatest philosophers of the 20th century, whose logical analysis philosophy profoundly influenced modern philosophy. As a pacifist and humanist, he consistently pursued truth and justice throughout his life, opposing war and inequality. Russell's writings span philosophy, mathematics, politics, education, and other fields, demonstrating his erudition and profound insights. His Nobel Prize in Literature not only recognized his literary achievements but also honored his contributions to human peace and freedom. Russell's intellectual legacy continues to inspire people to pursue rationality, critical thinking, and concern for human welfare.

critic.zh: 罗素的思想也面临诸多批评。一些哲学家认为他的逻辑原子主义过于简化复杂的世界，忽视了语言和社会因素。在政治立场上，罗素的和平主义被批评为不切实际，特别是在面对纳粹主义等极端威胁时。他的个人生活也充满争议，多次离婚和复杂的感情关系与传统道德观念相冲突。此外，罗素对中国等东方文化的理解被批评为表面化和西方中心主义。这些批评反映了罗素思想中的局限性和矛盾，也提醒我们即使是伟大的思想家也难以完全摆脱时代和文化的局限。
critic.en: Russell's ideas have also faced significant criticism. Some philosophers argue that his logical atomism oversimplifies the complex world, neglecting linguistic and social factors. Politically, his pacifism has been criticized as impractical, particularly when facing extreme threats like Nazism. His personal life was also controversial, with multiple divorces and complex relationships conflicting with traditional moral values. Furthermore, Russell's understanding of Eastern cultures like China has been criticized as superficial and Western-centric. These criticisms reflect the limitations and contradictions in Russell's thought, reminding us that even great thinkers cannot completely escape the limitations of their time and culture.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，罗素被定义为一位典型的公共知识分子，体现了知识分子的社会责任感。他既是严谨的学术研究者，又是积极的社会活动家，这种双重身份使他成为20世纪思想史上的重要人物。罗素的形象超越了单纯的哲学家标签，成为理性、批判性思维和道德勇气的象征。他的名言'我宁愿做一个人而不愿做一个正确的人'体现了他的核心价值取向。在当代流行文化中，罗素常被引用为反对盲从权威、追求独立思考的代表人物，他的思想对现代教育、科学哲学和政治哲学仍有重要影响。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Russell is defined as a quintessential public intellectual who exemplifies the social responsibility of thinkers. He was both a rigorous academic researcher and an active social activist, making him a significant figure in 20th-century intellectual history. Russell's image transcends the label of mere philosopher, becoming a symbol of rationality, critical thinking, and moral courage. His famous quote 'I would never die for my beliefs because I might be wrong' reflects his core values. In contemporary popular culture, Russell is often cited as a representative figure opposing blind obedience to authority and pursuing independent thought, and his ideas continue to influence modern education, philosophy of science, and political philosophy.

self.zh: 我宁愿做一个人而不愿做一个正确的人。
self.en: I would never die for my beliefs because I might be wrong.
